name: API key resolution has no silent shadow
prose: order is the pinned `apiKeyEnv`, then the standard env names (`MAGENTRA_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, …), then the stored key. `apiKeyEnv` used to be a PIN: naming a variable meant nothing else was consulted, so a pin left behind by a previous provider sent resolution past the key the app had just written and down to a stored key belonging to a different endpoint. Blank env vars no longer count as set. The resolved key reports its source, and a dangling pin raises a boot warning.
invariant: Key order is pinned apiKeyEnv, then standard env names, then the stored key; a pin never shadows the key just written, and blank env vars do not count as set.
